# W3Schools

> > W3Schools is the world's largest web development learning platform, offering free tutorials and references on web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, and more.

W3Schools provides interactive examples, exercises, and certification programs for developers of all skill levels. The platform covers front-end and back-end technologies, programming languages, databases, and web frameworks with hands-on learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Python
- SQL
- Web Development
- Programming Tutorials
- Certification
- Certificate Verification
- Online Learning
- Code Examples
- Web Technologies
- Front-end Development
- Back-end Development
- Interactive Tutorials

## Certification and Verification

- [Certificate of completion from W3schools](https://verify-dev.w3schools.com/): W3Schools certificate verification portal for validating course credentials
